title: Rory and the Valley of Blossoms
verses:
The moon floated high over valley and crest,
As Rory stepped slow through the shimmering glade.
The leaves whispered low as the earth went to rest,
And shadows stretched soft in the cool piney shade.

When Nia swooped down from the top of the hill,
While Psittaco chirped from a branch up above,
They called to their friends as the forest grew still,
To share in a valley of slumber and love.

Then Ricky skipped by with a bounce in his tread,
While Tilly walked slow with a peaceful delight.
And Benny stretched out on a moss-covered bed,
To watch all the stars glowing clear in the night.

A carpet of blossoms began to unfold,
Releasing a scent that was soothing and sweet.
The petals shone bright with a shimmering gold,
To cushion the tired little dinosaur feet.

Now Psittaco nestled right under a wing,
As Rory curled down with his tail near his nose.
The crickets started softly and sweetly to sing,
To bring all the friends to a sleepy repose.

The shadows fell long as the valley grew deep,
And starlight danced light on the calm, quiet streams.
The dinos all drifted together to sleep,
To journey away into magical dreams.
